mechanisms.rationale: The core atomic behavior contract of the Proposal: convert run() from execFileSync to a promisified execFile preserving {status,stdout,stderr} and err.status??1 (never reject), wrap the 7 isolated own-workspace blocks (13/17/18/19/20/21/22) in async functions, Promise.all ONLY that set, and keep every shared-resource block (1-7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 23, 24, 25) strictly serial/async-uniform and awaited in existing order — excluding the config.yml write/restore pairs (419/449, 585/645, 701/781, 807/841), the 4b/5b status mutations (:295-301, :337-350), block 9's shared-store HTTP server, and block 25's allTasks.length===2 sanity. Delivers AC3 (>=40% wall-clock), AC5 (falsifiable seriality diff as the concurrency-safety evidence), AC6. Independently shippable as a single control-flow edit verified green by the full suite (docs/plans/M222-dir-112.md stages it RED→GREEN).

Per-block output prefix (e.g. [qx45] PASS/FAIL) so interleaved concurrent output stays attributable to its origin block. Delivers AC4 via a deliberately-broken-assertion negative control run once. Independent of m-parallelize-isolated-blocks: it can ship alone (serial prefixing still gives attribution value) with a complete safety contract (output-only diff) and independent diagnostic value; shares the file but a distinct symbol, so the proofSurface does not collide.
